policy.supported_changes: Owners may patch only the specifically supported text fields and corresponding semantic references or labels. Preserve surviving literal signs, qualifiers, spelling, and placement. Do not silently force printed source discrepancies to a peer’s wording.

policy.physical_print_vs_inference: Keep the original fragment, covered marker cells, and source-derived inference provenance. policy.preconditions: Check each stable ID against the current source scan, target fragment, coordinates, semantic field boundaries, and current hashes before editing. policy.independent_reacceptance: After supported edits, independently inspect the current TIFF and the complete current TXT/model/verification-or-review-notes/preview quartet, including the full-page preview. Reaccept the page with current source and artifact hashes before any repository mirroring.
policy.mirroring: Mirror only the independently reaccepted current artifacts and receipts through the established owner workflow. These handoffs themselves grant no page acceptance and make no repository or canonical changes.
policy.human_history: Never replace a prior raw human answer with a source-derived reading. The LS023/LS113 raw answers remain literally illegible; their already owner-applied recoveries are archived separately and excluded from the 494 new handoffs.
